picks.editorial_note: A $14.2M DOE Genesis Mission award tasking a national lab with building a foundation model for the U.S. electric grid signals federal AI investment moving into critical infrastructure at scale.
picks.title: BNL to Lead $14M AI Project for Nation's Electric Grid Through Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: A $10M OpenAI Foundation grant to bring AI-powered weather and crop-disease forecasting to millions of farmers is a rare case of an AI investment with immediate, large-scale humanitarian impact.
picks.title: AIM for Scale receives $10 million to bring AI-powered weather services to millions of farmers

picks.editorial_note: UNSW's rollout of ChatGPT Edu to 80,000+ students and staff is one of the largest AI-in-education deployments in the Asia-Pacific region, a bellwether for how universities integrate frontier AI tools at scale.
picks.title: UNSW partners with OpenAI to support the first generation of AI natives in the workforce

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's ETCRAM analog memory achieves 100x efficiency gains for AI hardware, a materials-science advance that could meaningfully reduce the energy footprint of future AI systems.
picks.title: New analog memory may make smart devices even smarter

picks.editorial_note: OpenAI's claim of solving a Millennium Prize math problem, met with public skepticism from UCLA's Terence Tao, is a high-stakes test of AI mathematical reasoning capability and credibility.
picks.title: OpenAI says it has solved one of math’s 'Millennium Problems' — and more UCLA media

picks.editorial_note: USC's Genesis Mission awards for AI-enabled scientific workflows extend the DOE's flagship AI initiative into new research domains, reflecting a coordinated federal push on AI for science.
picks.title: USC researchers land major AI-driven grants from Department of Energy

picks.editorial_note: A $1.26M NIH grant pairing AlphaFold virtual screening with quantum sensing to fight antibiotic-resistant superbugs shows AI directly accelerating drug-discovery pipelines against a major public health threat.
picks.title: University of Houston Awarded $1.26M NIH Grant to Outsmart Superbugs | University of Houston

picks.editorial_note: A DOE-backed national team including the University of Kentucky advancing AI for mine safety and operations broadens Genesis Mission-style public-private AI collaboration into industrial applications.
picks.title: UK selected to help advance DOE ‘Mine of the Future’ initiative

picks.editorial_note: A national poll showing only 11% public support for local AI data centers highlights a growing social and political backlash that could shape AI infrastructure policy and siting decisions nationwide.
picks.title: Just 1 in 9 Americans Support AI Data Center Construction in their Local Communities, According to New UMass Amherst Poll | UMass Amherst

picks.editorial_note: Texas A&M's award-winning AI 'digital human' for early dementia detection demonstrates a clinically validated, real-world diagnostic application with recognized industry impact.
picks.title: AI-powered early dementia-detection tool earns Texas A&M a Fast Company Innovation by Design Award – Texas A&M Stories
